name: Liquid Metal
description: Liquid metal with the Rosensweig instability: above a critical field set by the surface-tension/gravity balance, the flat surface breaks into a hexagonal lattice of standing peaks whose amplitude saturates as the square root of the supercritical excess — the actual mechanism behind ferrofluid spikes. Shading uses an anisotropic Ward-style lobe stretched perpendicular to the flow with FFT-banded anisotropy. Height state stays in dataTextureA; reads move to exact textureLoad and the output gains ACES.

updatedParams.name: Viscosity
updatedParams.description: Surface relaxation rate; also raises the critical field for spiking.

updatedParams.name: Chromatic Spread
updatedParams.description: Channel split through the refracted surface.

updatedParams.name: Flow Speed
updatedParams.description: Rate the height field drains along the depth gradient.
